content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Graduate Degree from a university/institution recognized by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies, along with Professional certification in financial risk management from GARP or PRMIA Institute or at least two years experience as CRO in a regulated lending entity; Desirable: CFA, CA, CMA, PG in Finance/Economics/Banking/Risk Management/Business Administration or specialized certification in treasury/credit/operational/cyber/climate/model risk

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Punjab & Sind Bank Chief Risk Officer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Punjab & Sind Bank to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Punjab & Sind Bank Chief Risk Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Chief Risk Officer post is 12 September 2026. Candidates should ensure their applications are submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Risk Officer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Chief Risk Officer position in the Punjab & Sind Bank recruitment drive. Interested candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply Online for the Chief Risk Officer recruitment through the official website of Punjab & Sind Bank. Offline applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What are the age limits for the Chief Risk Officer post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Chief Risk Officer post must be between 40 years (minimum) and 55 years (maximum) of age as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the required qualifications for the Chief Risk Officer position?
faq.answer: Applicants should hold a Graduate Degree from a recognized university along with professional certification in financial risk management (GARP/PRMIA) or relevant experience. Desirable qualifications include CFA/CA/CMA/PG in Finance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates applying for the Chief Risk Officer post is Rs. 1180/- (including GST). This fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Chief Risk Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preliminary scrutiny, shortlisting, personal interaction/interview, assessment of knowledge and leadership abilities, and verification of credentials, leading to final selection based on interview merit.

faq.question: Q8. When does the online application start for Punjab & Sind Bank CRO recruitment?
faq.answer: The online application process for the Chief Risk Officer recruitment by Punjab & Sind Bank starts on 03 September 2026. Candidates can begin submitting their forms from this date.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF containing all details for this recruitment can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided within this article. It is advisable to read it carefully.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Punjab & Sind Bank?
faq.answer: The official website for Punjab & Sind Bank, where candidates can find more information and apply, is https://punjabandsind.bank.in/. Please visit for further details.
